news.title: Over 73,100 new houses approved under PMAY-Urban 2.0 in Uttar Pradesh
news.para: The Uttar Pradesh government has greenlit the construction of 73,184 new homes under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban 2.0 initiative, increasing the total number of sanctioned residences to 4,88,526 statewide. Chief Secretary S P Goyal called for stringent adherence to quality standards and timely project completion. He highlighted the necessity for quick delivery of housing to beneficiaries, with officials set to monitor progress rigorously to avert any delays.

news.title: Over 30 illegal buildings demolished in Gurugram for violating norms
news.para: Gurgaon's civic body demolished thirty-one structures during a citywide enforcement drive.  This action targeted unauthorized constructions and building bye-law violations across several areas.  The demolition drive is part of a month-long campaign following Supreme Court directions.  Officials stated illegal construction will not be tolerated and enforcement is ongoing.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh brings in OTS scheme for pending property tax dues
news.para: The Uttar Pradesh government has launched a new settlement scheme for property tax arrears. This initiative aims to recover pending house, water, and sewerage taxes across urban areas. Taxpayers can settle old dues through a simple process and avoid defaulter status. The scheme allows payment in a maximum of three installments over three months. Recovered revenue will fund improvements in public facilities and development works.

news.title: Ahmedabad: Building permission may be denied if area’s drainage is patchy
news.para: Ahmedabad might start denying development permissions for projects that do not include necessary drainage infrastructure. Recent heavy rainfall unveiled severe waterlogging in Bopal, Ghuma, and Shela, prompting authorities to reassess project approvals. This initiative aims to curb future flooding risks and enhance urban development. Major investments are already taking place to tackle these pressing infrastructure challenges.

news.title: Goa: 9.7 lakh sq metres of land parcels notified as non-developable
news.para: The TCP department has revised the Regional Plan 2021, marking 9.7 lakh sqm as non-developable land. This area encompasses Majorda, Gonsua, and Sao Jorge Island, playing a vital role in preserving critical ecosystems. After thorough public review and consideration by the TCP Board, the proposals have received final approval. However, the implementation hinges on the high court's resolution of ongoing writ petitions, reinforcing protection for these ecologically significant zones.

news.title: Hyderabad development body to auction prime land parcels in Kokapet
news.para: Prime lands in Hyderabad's Kokapet area are set for auction by the Hyderabad Metropolitan Development Authority. The upset prices start at ₹120 crore per acre for the Neopolis layout and ₹70 crore for Golden Mile. In addition, several residential plots throughout Hyderabad will also be sold. The auction is scheduled from August 24 to September 9, with the authority expecting to raise substantial revenue from these transactions.

news.title: More than 90% projects in Kolkata didn’t have any structural issue: Audit
news.para: In a recent safety audit, most highrise projects were confirmed to be structurally sound, with around half having resumed construction and more on the way. This initiative followed a severe warehouse collapse, prompting the government to review 706 projects. Notably, only 26 of these showed significant violations, none associated with Credai members. Consequently, Credai is actively advising buyers to select units in RERA-approved developments.

news.title: Westpac reports 20% drop in mortgage applications after Australia scraps tax breaks
news.para: Westpac has announced a notable decline in mortgage applications, predicting a slower growth in investor housing credit. The downturn is primarily linked to federal tax reforms and increasing interest rates, which are curtailing property demand. Additionally, the bank's quarterly cash earnings have diminished compared to last year, raising concerns among analysts about future earnings challenges for Australian banks. Nevertheless, persistent housing undersupply and population growth might help mitigate these issues.

news.title: Brookfield India REIT's net operating income rises 8% to ₹756.6 crore  in Q1 FY27
news.para: Brookfield India REIT reported net operating income of ₹756.6 crore in Q1 FY27, with NOI growing 8% year-on-year. The REIT also reported net profit of ₹221.33 crore and approved acquisition of a 50% stake in a Godrej BKC office asset in Mumbai.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh RERA asks 470 complainants to submit bank details for refund transfer
news.para: Uttar Pradesh RERA has directed 470 complainants to submit updated bank account details through notarised affidavits. The authority said money recovered from promoters through recovery certificates could not be transferred in these cases due to missing bank account documents.

news.title: Leela Palaces to invest up to ₹185 crore in Ayodhya hotel subsidiary
news.para: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts will invest up to ₹185 crore in Buildminds, its subsidiary developing an upcoming five-star hotel in Ayodhya. The investment will be made through subscription to compulsorily convertible preference shares.

news.title: IFC invests ₹225 crore in NDR Smart Spaces
news.para: International Finance Corporation has made an equity investment of ₹225 crore in NDR Smart Spaces, a platform by the NDR group. The investment will support development of about 20 million sq ft of Grade-A warehousing and logistics infrastructure across 14 cities.

news.title: DDA conversion policy for residential properties under review to make it more citizen-friendly
news.para: Currently under examination, the Delhi Development Authority's residential property conversion policy seeks to make it easier for citizens to navigate requests. As a result, all requests are temporarily paused until the new regulations are set. The recent changes in circle rates announced by the Delhi government also play a role, with expectations to finalize the conversion rates soon in order to restart services.

news.title: Ambit Realtors & Developers accelerates redevelopment of Mumbai’s Western Suburbs; With an estimated gross revenue of approximately ₹2,500 crore during FY26
news.para: Ambit Realtors is transforming Mumbai's western suburbs through significant redevelopment projects.  The company is advancing initiatives in Malad West and Borivali West areas.  These developments add substantial area to Ambit's redevelopment pipeline.  Cluster redevelopment creates larger open spaces and better community planning.  This approach aims to build future-ready neighborhoods for residents.

news.title: About 66% mutation cases disposed of online: Bihar revenue minister
news.para: The integration of online revenue services and departmental oversight has significantly expedited the resolution of land cases. In the period of 2026-27, 66% of mutation cases and 31% of Maha-Abhiyan applications were effectively resolved. A surge of over five lakh online mutation applications was processed, and digitized Jamabandi records facilitated the disposal of more than six lakh cases through Parimarjan Plus.

news.title: Indore: 8.5% rise in property registrations in last four months
news.para: Indore's real estate market has witnessed a thriving boost, with property transactions rising by 8.5 percent, generating significant revenue for the state. The expansion of outer corridors and emerging zones is driving this surge. Interestingly, property sales in older, central regions are experiencing a slight downturn. Overall, this trend highlights a strong rebound in the local property sector.

news.title: Nagpur: 88% of buildings lack OCs, union minister sets four-month deadline to resolve issue
news.para: Nearly eighty-eight percent of Nagpur's buildings lack mandatory Occupancy Certificates. Union minister Nitin Gadkari directed notices for pending issues within four months. Registrations of independent houses will continue under existing legal rules. Confusion arose over building permission certificates and Occupancy Certificates for large buildings. Developers failing to obtain Occupancy Certificates will not be allowed property registration.

news.title: Bihar government eyes digitisation of five crore land and property records
news.para: Bihar is undertaking a monumental task by digitizing nearly five crore land registration records dating back to 1908. This innovative initiative aims to ensure that property documents are not only secure but also easily accessible online for citizens. While records from 1996 onward have been successfully digitized and verified, the department's current focus is on the older documents from the 1990-95 period.
